Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
Entity
Enemy
public class Enemy extends Entity
Enemy class represents an enemy entity in a game. The class extends the entity class. It inherits the name and hp from entity. The class inherits from the Entity class, which provides a general structure for game entities.
